meta.title: Kestrel Trunk Annex
meta.units: metres, 0.5 m grid, x east, z north, centred on the site

speeds.note: walk = gear 3 stand (2.0 m/s); crawl = crouch gear 2 in a 1.3 m duct

spaces.name: Loading yard
spaces.landmark: sodium lamp pools, parked van, drum stacks
spaces.purpose: Arrival, the loop is learned here; vehicle exit

spaces.name: Goods-in bay
spaces.purpose: Entry room, breaker-free dark corner with the riser ladder

spaces.name: Break room
spaces.purpose: Pair's break stop, body room, reinforcement entry (sealed street door)

spaces.name: Switch hall
spaces.landmark: rack rows, gallery above, open stair
spaces.purpose: Hub: pair patrol, gallery vantage, stair to O1

spaces.name: Generator room
spaces.purpose: Breaker board, yard door, back door to the cage room

spaces.name: Fire stair (ground)
spaces.purpose: Yard to roof, enclosed, only stair with doors

spaces.name: Core switch cage
spaces.landmark: mesh wall, two rack rows, lit sign CORE

spaces.name: Test room
spaces.landmark: test bench, line-record cabinet with lit sign

spaces.name: Control room
spaces.landmark: monitor wall, glazed window onto the gallery
spaces.purpose: Officer, alarm panel AP1, window overlooking the hall

spaces.name: Gallery
spaces.landmark: rail over the hall, recess, ladder hatch
spaces.purpose: Vantage and link between Test room, Control room and roof ladder

spaces.name: Fire stair head house
spaces.purpose: Roof end of the fire stair

openings.purpose: Arrival gate (padlock swapped by the team), alternate exit
Fire door to the fire stair
Cage entrance in the mesh wall
Mesh wall: sight and light pass, bodies do not
Stair mouth into the Test room
Glazed window: the officer's view of the hall
Roof door of the fire stair

links.note: 2.4 wide, 20 risers 0.165 x 0.285 (slope 0.58), mid landing 2.0, along the hall's south wall, foot at the east end
enclosed 1.3 m flights, 40 risers, doors FD1 and FD3
exterior ladder on the south facade, 0.5 wide
cable riser, 1.0 x 1.0 shaft at x -17.5..-16.5, ladder reached from the east
gallery to roof hatch, shaft 1.0 x 1.0 at x -5.5..-4.5, z 13..14 in the north-west corner of the gallery
exhaust shaft: roof stack to the cage east aisle, 1.0 x 1.0, 6.6 m ladder
cable trench under the hall and the generator room, 0.9 wide x 1.3 high, grille T1 in the Goods-in bay, hatch T2 in the cage room

lamps.note: security light on the head house
inside the personnel door, over the work bench
north lane and the cage door
over the yard door and hall door
south apron of the cage room
west aisle, over the hatch T2
gallery south, by the Test door

circuits.name: Yard and roof security lights
circuits.reaction: G1 walks to pole lamp Y2 and searches 12 s with a torch; G6 holds on the yard 10 s. A shot lamp: G1 goes to that lamp, 8 s.

circuits.name: Ground west (Goods-in, break room)

switch.note: on the east wall south of the wide opening, hidden from the hall

circuits.reaction: Pair breaks the loop at the next waypoint, walks to the dark room, searches 10 s, resumes.

circuits.name: Switch hall

switch.note: hall north-west wall, under the gallery

circuits.reaction: Pair and G4 converge on the hall centre, 15 s search; G5 turns to face the mesh 6 s.

circuits.name: Generator room

switch.note: breaker board BP, west wall of the generator room

circuits.reaction: Pair detours to the board 12 s (the only circuit they walk to), then resume. Nobody re-lights it.

circuits.name: Cage room

switch.note: inside the cage room, beside the service door GCd

circuits.reaction: G5 stops, scans 8 s, goes to AP2 only if he sees a person. Pair investigates after 15 s.

circuits.name: Upper floor (Test room, gallery, control room)

switch.note: Test room east wall, next to the gallery door

circuits.reaction: G4 leaves the desk, checks the Test room door and the gallery 15 s with a torch.

panels.note: officer's panel, west wall of the control room
east wall of the cage room, on the aisle mouth
yard wall beside the vehicle gate

reinforce.name: North street door (ND, sealed to the player)

hides.enclosure: DS1 on the east (south half), walls south and west; dark, 8 m or more from the sentry
DS1 west, wall south (behind the sentry while he checks the door)
bins north, wall south (1.4 m: crouch)
porch walls at the fire door
crate bay: east wall, south wall beside PD, a crate on the west
drum rack south, walls north and west, riser shaft R1 inside
stair block west, walls south and east
cabinet bay in the west wall, under the gallery
racks CR2 west, walls north and east
recess cut into the control room wall
AHU north, parapet-free roof, 1.0 m kerb
chiller south: out of the sniper's line

shows.what: door check at A and the Y1 pool, from deep in the pocket through the gap
officer's door check on the gallery, through the void
sniper on the lane facing, 24 m away
officer at the desk through the window
heavy across the mesh, from above the racks

spawns.first: Climb the exterior ladder RL to the roof
Out through the gap to the personnel door PD
Along the south wall east behind the van (yard run)
Wait at the pocket mouth and watch the sentry

objectives.name: Pull the circuit record
objectives.why: Names the broker's line card LC-4471. Without it the tap has nothing to clip to.

objectives.name: Plant the tap
objectives.why: Clip the tap onto line card LC-4471 in the core switch.

guards.why: The contract names the yard gate and the personnel door as the two ways in. One man walks the line.
tells: boots on gravel, audible 6 s before each leg ends
torch beam sweeps the wall 3 s before he turns at the door

reaction.lights: C1 off: goes to Y2 and searches 12 s, then resumes
reaction.body: stops, calls it, runs to AP3 (alarm), 3 reinforcements at the lane

guards.post: Hall west lane and break room

wps.what: break room, kettle, backs to the hall
south junction, looks at the wide opening and stair

guards.why: The hall is the asset (relay racks). After a past theft the contractor ordered no one patrols the hall alone: a pair.
tells: radio crackle and two voices in the break room, 4 s before they come out
door slap of the double door DD, 2 s before they appear

reaction.lights: C3 off: both go to the hall centre, 15 s search. C4 off: they walk to the board
reaction.body: G2 runs to AP2 or AP1 (nearest), G3 guards the body

wps.what: south junction, covers the west side

guards.why: Second man of the pair; trails so the pair never stand on top of each other.
tells: radio crackle in the break room, 2.5 s after G2's

guards.post: Control room desk and the gallery

wps.what: desk, watches the hall through the window

guards.why: The contract needs a duty officer who logs the rounds, watches the monitors and works the alarm panel. The records are the second most valuable thing, so he checks that door.
tells: keys on his belt, 2 s before he opens DC
CL1 lamp flickers on the window glass 3 s before he stands

reaction.lights: C6 off: leaves the desk, checks the Test door and the gallery 15 s
reaction.body: runs to AP1 at once, then orders a search

wps.what: apron, looks up the centre aisle
console check, back to the aisle mouth

guards.why: The cage is what the broker protects: the core switch holds his private line card. A heavy with a shotgun because the threat is a theft crew, not a trespasser.
tells: heavy tread and armour clink through the mesh, 4 s before he reaches the apron
his shadow swings across the K1 pool on the apron 2 s before he arrives

reaction.lights: C5 off: stops and scans 8 s, then resumes
reaction.body: does not leave the cage: stands at AP2, rings it

guards.why: The only way a vehicle or a roof team can reach the building is the lane and the roof. A previous break-in came over the roof.
tells: the scope glints in the sodium light 2 s before each turn
boot scrape on the roof gravel 3 s before each turn

reaction.lights: C1 off: stays on the yard facing 10 s then sweeps
reaction.body: does not leave the roof; reports by radio, AP not used

chokes.name: Yard east crossing to GD and Gv

routes.name: Stair route
routes.teaches: The hall is the pair's room. Read the junction, cross while they sit in the break room.
routes.risk: medium-high: lit crossing in view of the pair

routes.name: Roof and gallery
routes.teaches: Quiet, long, and the officer owns the gallery. Shadow and the recess carry you.

routes.name: Riser ladder (hidden)
routes.teaches: A way up that skips the hall. Found by looking in the Goods-in corner.

routes.name: Hall and cage door
routes.teaches: Fast and bold: through the heavy's door, up his own aisle in the dark between the racks.
routes.risk: high: apron and aisle are the heavy's beat

routes.name: Yard and generator room
routes.teaches: Use the south wall shadow, time the yard hop, then take the dark east aisle.
routes.risk: medium: yard crossing under the sniper

routes.name: Roof and exhaust shaft
routes.teaches: Drop in behind the racks. Costs a ladder you cannot fight on and a roof the sniper watches.
routes.risk: medium-high: roof under the sniper, helpless on the shaft

routes.name: Trench variant (bypasses CH and hall)
routes.teaches: A silent 23 m crawl under the hall. The hatch opens on the lit apron.
routes.risk: medium: grille seen from the wide opening, noise on entry, apron on exit

routes.name: Generator room to the van (primary)
routes.teaches: A calm walk with one test: the last 6 m of open yard under both the sentry and the sniper.

routes.name: Hall, Goods-in and the arrival gate (alternate)
routes.teaches: Back the way you came: the quiet exit when the east yard is hot.

rewards.name: The riser ladder R1
rewards.where: Goods-in north-west corner, behind the pallets (-15.5, 1.0)
rewards.unlocks: A way into the Test room that skips the hall, the stair and the pair. O1 in about 20 s.
rewards.learn: A ladder foot shows in the Goods-in corner from the wide opening; a pinned cable chart in the break room names 'RISER 1'.

rewards.name: The cable trench D1
rewards.where: Grille T1 in the Goods-in bay (-9.0, -1.5)
rewards.unlocks: A silent 23 m crawl under the hall and the generator room to the cage room. Skips the hall, CH and the pair.
rewards.learn: The grille is visible from the wide opening; a cable-pit label and a draught that moves the dust. Cost: 26 s crawl, noise on entry.

rewards.name: The exhaust shaft ES
rewards.unlocks: A drop into the cage's dark east aisle behind the racks, 4 m from O2.
rewards.learn: The stack is visible from the AHU cover on the roof, and the cage's east aisle shows a hatch grille when seen from the apron.

coop.co: One player at breaker board BP (SW4) kills C4 and a partner crosses the generator room
coop.solo: Shoot Y/GN lamps from cover (noise radius), or go the long way via the south wall

coop.co: A spotter on gallery V4 pings the pair and the heavy; a runner uses the call
coop.solo: Spend one guard loop (40 s) at V4, then go

coop.co: One player pulls O1 while another waits in the east aisle for O2
coop.solo: Do O1, then O2 in order (O1 gives the card number)
coop.gain: About 90 s saved; no waiting for each other

coop.co: One player takes down G2, another drags and hides the body at hGe1
coop.solo: Takedown, drag it 8 m yourself, 10 s slower

coop.co: Two players at the break-room double door DD: one pings the pair's timing, one slips past
coop.solo: Wait for the pair to be inside (6 s)

coop.co: A partner down in the cage room east aisle (hCa1) is revived by another coming down ES
coop.solo: Not needed: no revive in solo
coop.gain: A rescue route that is out of the heavy's view

coop.co: Four players enter by four different routes at once (RL, PD, south wall, trench) and meet in the east aisle
coop.gain: No queue at any door: the ladder, the wide opening and the yard are separate

assets.name: Arrival gate Gp (1.2 m)
assets.story: The team's way in: the contractor's padlock was swapped by the Client's contact.
assets.helps: A fixed, safe start and an alternate exit.
assets.hurts: Players may think it is the only exit.
assets.fix: The radio names Gv as the van point.

assets.name: Vehicle gate Gv (3.0 m)
assets.story: The delivery lane. The van waits here.
assets.helps: The primary extraction, in view of the sentry and the sniper.
assets.hurts: A wide gate can feel like a hole in the wall.
assets.fix: Closed until extraction; chained; the sentry checks it.

assets.name: Personnel door PD (1.2 m)
assets.helps: The main way in: 1 door to the whole ground floor.
assets.fix: G1's door check and the sniper's yard facing give a timed window.

assets.name: Roller door RD (sealed, 3.0 m)
assets.story: The delivery door, shuttered at night.
assets.helps: Reads the Goods-in bay from the yard; the landmark.
assets.fix: No handle, no prompt.

assets.name: Generator door GD (1.2 m)
assets.story: Fuel deliveries and engineers use it.
assets.helps: A side route to the cage room that skips the hall.
assets.hurts: Too close to the van: a free exit.
assets.fix: It sits in the sniper's blind strip but the 6 m yard hop to Gv is the exit test.

assets.name: Fire door FD1 (1.2 m)
assets.helps: The route to the roof by the fire stair.
assets.fix: The stair ends 4 m from the sniper, so the cost is real.

assets.name: Wide opening WO1 (3.0 m)
assets.story: Goods lorries bring racks into the hall.
assets.helps: Lets two players move together; no door fiddling.
assets.hurts: Open sight line between the bay and the hall.
assets.fix: The hall side is under the gallery in shadow.

assets.name: Break-room double door DD (2.0 m)
assets.story: The break room opens on the hall.
assets.helps: Gives the pair a visible pause: both go behind it for 6 s.
assets.hurts: A hiding place that attracts the pair.
assets.fix: Reward is the dark body spot; the pair always comes out.

assets.name: Hall-to-generator double door DG (2.0 m)
assets.helps: Links the hall to the board room for the co-op light trick.
assets.fix: It is in the pair's south-junction view.

assets.name: Cage door CH (2.0 m)
assets.story: Authorised entry to the core switch.
assets.helps: The fast, risky route into the heavy's room.
assets.fix: GCd, T2 and ES bypass it.

assets.name: Mesh wall (x=6, z 4-14)
assets.story: A security cage around the core equipment.
assets.helps: Sight and light pass: the heavy can be watched from the gallery.
assets.hurts: The heavy sees you in the hall.
assets.fix: Hall's east side is rack-covered; the west lane under the gallery is dark.

assets.name: Cage service door GCd (1.2 m)
assets.story: Maintenance access for the switch engineers.
assets.helps: A slow, safe way to the dark east aisle.
assets.fix: Its light switch SW5 is next to it: the player's choice.

assets.name: Street door ND (sealed)
assets.story: The response car's door from the street.
assets.helps: Gives reinforcement an entry point so the alarm has a direction.
assets.hurts: Players think it is an exit.
assets.fix: Barred; no prompt.

assets.name: Test door DT2 (1.2 m)
assets.story: The records are behind a locked-by-habit door.
assets.helps: Gallery entry to O1; G4 checks it each loop.
assets.hurts: Could be an easy O1 path.
assets.fix: The officer's check and the gallery risk.

assets.name: Control door DC (1.2 m)
assets.helps: The officer's route is readable.
assets.fix: The room is a dead end with a lit desk and AP1.

assets.name: Control window W1 (3.0 m)
assets.story: A glazed window so the officer can watch the hall.
assets.helps: The stationary narrow view; the player can read him from V4.
assets.fix: The desk is 6 m back; the gallery is in shadow.

assets.name: Stair mouth SO (2.5 m wide opening)
assets.story: The stair top runs into the Test room.
assets.helps: Direct, no door.
assets.fix: Rail and TL1's lamp are the risk.

assets.name: Roof door FD3 (1.2 m)
assets.helps: The roof entry by the fire stair.
assets.fix: The head house blocks his south-east view.

assets.name: Open stair S1 (2.4 m wide)
assets.story: The engineers' main stair up to the test and control floor.
assets.helps: The main O1 route; a landmark; a lit, exposed climb.
assets.fix: The foot lobby hH1 is a dark pocket.

assets.name: Fire stair FS (1.3 m)
assets.story: The fire code requires a protected stair.
assets.helps: A quiet 20 s route to the roof for the team.
assets.fix: It is optional: RL is the alternative.

assets.name: Exterior ladder RL (0.5 m)
assets.helps: The first move from S1.
assets.hurts: A ladder is slow and noisy.
assets.fix: It is out of the sniper's range (28 m).

assets.name: Riser ladder R1 (1.0 x 1.0 shaft)
assets.story: Cable riser from the Goods-in to the Test room.
assets.helps: A discoverable shortcut; skips the hall.
assets.fix: Hidden behind the drums; the ladder is slow.

assets.name: Gallery-roof ladder GL (1.0 x 1.0 shaft)
assets.helps: Links the roof with the gallery.
assets.fix: The north end is 5 m from the recess.

assets.name: Exhaust shaft ES (1.0 x 1.0 shaft)
assets.helps: The skilled drop-in: 4 m from O2, behind the racks.
assets.fix: Roof under the sniper; a 7 s helpless ladder.

assets.name: Cable trench D1 (0.9 x 1.3, player only)
assets.story: Under-floor cable duct from the Goods-in to the cage.
assets.helps: A silent bypass of the hall and the door.
assets.fix: 23 m at 0.9 m/s is 26 s; grille T1 is in view from WO1; noise on entry; the hatch is lit.

assets.name: Grille T1 (Goods-in)
assets.helps: The entry the player must discover.
assets.fix: Entry rattles at a radius of 4 m.

assets.name: Hatch T2 (cage room)
assets.helps: Opens beside the cage door.
assets.hurts: Next to the heavy's west aisle.
assets.fix: K2 lights it: the player pays to emerge.

assets.name: Yard and roof lights C1 (5 lamps)
assets.helps: Switching it off gives the yard to the player.
assets.fix: Sentry and sniper investigate.

assets.name: Ground west C2 (3 lamps)
assets.helps: Darkens the way in and the riser.
assets.fix: The pair investigate.

assets.name: Switch hall C3 (4 lamps)
assets.helps: Makes the hall crossing possible.
assets.hurts: Switch is on the far wall.
assets.fix: Pair and officer converge.

assets.name: Generator room C4 (2 lamps)
assets.helps: The co-op breaker board.
assets.fix: Solo can shoot lamps.

assets.name: Cage room C5 (2 lamps)
assets.helps: Darkens the apron.
assets.fix: 8 s scan.

assets.name: Upper floor C6 (3 lamps)
assets.story: Test room, gallery and control room.
assets.helps: Darkens O1.
assets.fix: 15 s search.

assets.name: Alarm panel AP1 (control room)
assets.helps: G4's 1-second response is a test.
assets.fix: Takedown G4 first.

assets.name: Alarm panel AP2 (cage room east wall)
assets.helps: G5 has a goal.
assets.hurts: The heavy rings it too fast.
assets.fix: He only rings it if he sees a person.

assets.name: Alarm panel AP3 (yard)
assets.helps: Reinforcements at the van.
assets.fix: Alternate exit E2.

assets.name: Control room
assets.story: The monitor room: the surveillance room. Cameras are PARKED, so the monitors show a static schematic.
assets.helps: A stationary watcher with a narrow view.
assets.fix: The officer leaves for the gallery.

assets.name: Guard post G1 (yard line)
assets.helps: Door check and gate check: two readable pauses.
assets.fix: Dark hides at 8 m.

assets.name: Guard posts G2/G3 (break room, south junction)
assets.helps: The pair's gap is the break.
assets.fix: 2.5 s offset.

assets.name: Guard post G4 (desk, Test door)
assets.helps: A short walk and a long pause.
assets.fix: Recess hU1.

assets.name: Guard post G5 (apron, west aisle, console)
assets.helps: A rhythm with 18 s of back-turned time.
assets.fix: East aisle is dark.

assets.name: Guard post G6 (roof parapet)
assets.helps: A fixed narrow watcher over the yard.
assets.fix: A blind strip at the foot of the wall.
